title: HÄGGVECKMAL room darkening curtains
description: HÄGGVECKMAL room darkening curtains, 1 pair, dark green/with heading tape, 57x84" HÄGGVECKMAL room darkening curtains with classic dark green tartan pattern, wool-like expression and matching backing, give a good amount of privacy. 84¼" length – perfect for window height.
features: The measurement applies to each curtain panel.
The curtains are sold in pairs. The sizes stated refer to each single curtain. For the total width, double the width of a single curtain.
Since the fabric will shrink when washing it is a good idea to wash the curtains prior to cutting/hemming.
Use SY iron-on hemming strip to shorten the curtains without sewing.
16 gliders and hooks are usually recommended for each curtain with a width of 57⅛". You can increase or decrease the number depending on whether you want narrower or fuller folds in the pleats.
